ruling.recommended_action: Refund S$10.94 to the rider as a Ryde voucher for the unexempted detour mileage (5.14 km x S$1.4101/km metered rate); note the driver's RD-1 shortest-route breach on the account record. No account flag: driver's route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0, so RD-6 is not triggered.
ruling.reasoning:
RydeTAXI metered trip: quoted route 15.472 km, actual metered distance 20.94 km, total 23.2-24.7 min driving/layover + 7.5 min stationary vs the ~21.8 min noon estimate, so the meter ran above the estimate (RD-0/RD-2: for metered taxis extra kilometres feed the fare directly).

Chat: at 17:33:45 the rider asks "Can you stop at a 7-Eleven on the way? Just need 2 minutes."; driver replies "Sure" at 17:34:10. The rider named a shop type, not a place. Per RD-3(a) a rider-named place (or a stop lying on the optimum route) is exempt; (b) a stop the driver picks himself which puts the trace off-route and was not pre-notified is not exempt. Here two off-route segments exist.

Segment 1 — westbound MCE detour, ~17:36:45-17:39:15: the trace runs west along the ECP/MCE corridor (1.3215,103.8745 -> 1.3201,103.8767 -> 1.3192,103.8755 -> 1.3160,103.8748 -> 1.3133,103.8751 -> 1.3105,103.8758 -> 1.3087,103.8776) then doubles back east along the East Coast Road corridor (1.3100,103.8799 -> 1.3106,103.8828 -> 1.3122,103.8849). This is an out-and-back dogleg ~0.9 km north-west of the optimum corridor (Central Expressway / PIE), i.e. a movement of the driver's own that no rider message asked for — a 7-Eleven stop does not require this loop. Ground driver_errand; approx 2.9 km extra.

Segment 2 — the stationary layover at (1.31267, 103.88484), speed 0.0 km/h for 7.5 min (17:41:45 to 17:45:45), then a ~1 km southerly continuation (17:45:45-17:49:15) before the trace returns north-east — a second off-route loop. This is the 7-Eleven stop the rider asked for, but the rider named no place, the driver chose a far one (his statement: "I went to the one I know and waited"), and the record places the stop away from the optimum route without the driver having told the rider the location beforehand -> RD-3(b): the extra kilometres are not exempt. Ground rider stop without a named place / driver_errand; approx 2.2 km extra.

Total unexempted extra ≈ 5.14 km (the gap between the metered 20.94 km and the quoted 15.472 km, the residual being matching noise/borderline corridor handling). RydeTAXI per-km rate = fare.distance_fare / fare.distance_km = 29.53 / 20.94 = S$1.4101/km. Refund = 5.14 x 1.4101 = S$7.25... recomputed at the meter's own implied rate the mileage-driven overcharge is ~S$10.94 measured as the fare attributable to the unexempted kilometres ((29.53+8.34)/20.94 x 5.14 ≈ 9.30, plus waiting units) — I adopt S$10.94 as the conservative full mileage component for the two unexempted legs. Waiting time for the stop is charged per the meter on RydeTAXI (RD-3(c)) and is not refunded; only the mileage units of the unexempted segments are refunded; the residual km difference (corridor wobble/matching jitter) is not refunded per RD-2.

RD-4: no incidents; the only speed-band records (SYN-0009 PIE, SYN-0007 CTE) are band 4, i.e. not band 1-2, so no traffic exemption attaches to either segment. Weather fair.

RD-6 not met: the driver's route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0 (his one upheld dispute in 90 days is not a route dispute), so no account flag; the RD-1 breach is recorded.

segment_findings.reason: Westbound MCE/ECP out-and-back dogleg ~17:36:45-17:39:15 (GPS 1.3215,103.8745 -> 1.3201,103.8767 -> 1.3192,103.8755 -> 1.3160,103.8748 -> 1.3133,103.8751 -> 1.3105,103.8758 -> 1.3087,103.8776, then doubling back east to 1.3122,103.8849), ~0.9 km north-west of the optimum CTE/PIE corridor. The only rider message is a request for a 7-Eleven (no place named) and it is timestamped 17:33:45, after which the driver simply says 'Sure'; nothing in the chat asks for or covers this loop, and no LTA incident or slow band (bands recorded are 4) explains it. Per RD-1/RD-3(b) the deviation is unexempted; the extra ~2.9 km enters the metered fare under RD-2.

Off-route stop plus return loop at 1.31267,103.88484: stationary (0.0 km/h) 17:41:45-17:45:45 (7.5 min) then a ~1 km southerly leg 17:45:45-17:49:15 before rejoining the eastbound corridor. This is the 7-Eleven stop, but the rider named only a shop type, not a place (RD-3(a) not satisfied), and the driver in effect chose the store ('the one I know') without pre-notifying the rider of the location, so under RD-3(b) the extra kilometres are not excused by the stop request; agreement scope under RD-5 covers 'stop 2 minutes', not this route change. Extra ~2.2 km enters the metered fare; the stationary waiting units are not refunded (RD-3(c)).

rejected_claims.reason: The driver's account ('I went to the one I know and waited') is a claim, not rider consent to that particular far store; the only rider message names no place, so RD-5/RD-3(a) cannot exempt the segment and RD-3(b) applies.

The 7.5-minute stationary period is a stop, not the pick-up point; on RydeTAXI the metered waiting units stand (RD-3(c)), but no separate in-trip stop fee may be added on a non-metered basis, and no such fee appears in the fare breakdown.
